description: <p>LAHORE: A private transport company had to sack a conductor who pushed a woman off a bus when she was trying to board the vehicle at a terminal here on Friday, after a video of the episode went viral, grabbing the attention of the Punjab government.</p> <p>Some passersby recorded video of the incident and shared it on social media, triggering public outrage and the government’s reaction.The video shows the woman was trying to board the bus when the conductor pushed her. headline: Sindh decides to replace petrol vehicles with EVs
description: <p>KARACHI: The Sindh government has decided to gradually replace conventional vehicles used in government departments with electric vehicles (EVs), in a move aimed at cutting expenditure, saving fuel and reducing pollution.</p> <p>The decision was taken at a meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Austerity, chaired by Senior Minister Sharjeel Inam Memon and attended by Local Government Minister Syed Nasir Hussain Shah.</p> <p>The meeting reviewed measures to reduce government expenditure, save fuel and assess the vehicle requirements of various departments.</p&gt

headline: Snowfall strands passengers, cargo at Khunjerab
description: <p>GILGIT: Heavy snowfall and rain continued to cause hardships for residents of Gilgit-Baltistan on Friday, leaving a large number of passengers, tourists, vehicles and cargo containers stranded at Khunjerab Pass on the Pakistan-China border.</p> <p>Three containers reportedly skidded off the Karakoram Highway (KKH) after the road became slippery. Their drivers were rescued. Gilgit-Baltistan Minister for Tourism Naiknaam Karim was also among the stranded passengers and expressed concern over the lack of facilities and machinery to clear snow on the Pakistani side.</p>
